messages: Aria Gomez: Noticed CI failing on docs link-checker after the docusaurus rollout: several links to anchor ids are 404ing. Happens when headings have parentheses or non-ascii chars. Evan Li: Saw that too. The check output shows mismatched hashes rather than missing pages. Example from CI: ``` link-checker: ERROR https://docs.redwood.com/guides/llm-ops#model-selection -> 404 (anchor not found) ``` Rina (docs): This is the slug normalization difference again. Docusaurus (remark-slug) lowercases and strips punctuation differently than mkdocs-material. We have three options: 1) normalize slugs at build time, 2) add explicit HTML anchors in markdown, or 3) update all internal links to the new slugs. Aria Gomez: Option 3 sounds invasive across ~200 files. I'd vote for a canonicalizer script + redirects so old links don't break. Evan Li: Agreed. Small script plan: parse headings, compute new slug via docusaurus rules, add an HTML anchor immediately before the heading with the old slug so both work. Quick pseudo: ``` # bash-ish grep -n "^#" docs/**/*.md | while read l; do title=$(extract_title "$l") new=$(docuslug "$title") old=$(mkslug "$title") if [ "$old" != "$new" ]; then insert "" before heading fi done ``` Rina (docs): I can make a remark plugin instead to inject aliases for headings. That'd be cleaner than modifying source files. But plugin churn might require review from infra. QA-bot: docs-ci/link-checker job #982 failed: 7 unresolved anchors. infra-team: If a remark plugin is the route, infra needs a small acceptance test to ensure plugin runs in our build image. We can add it to the docs-build matrix. Aria Gomez: For a hotfix, can someone add a few explicit anchors in the most trafficked guides (llm-ops, deploy, api-reference)? That would lower customer impact while we decide. Evan Li: I'll open a PR with anchors for llm-ops and api-reference. Will include a short script in tools/ that maps the old->new and prints a dry-run. Rina (docs): Filing issue #324 in docs repo: "anchorcompat: reconcile mkdocs -> docusaurus slug differences" with proposed solutions and owners. Assigning to @Evan for hotfix PR and @infra-team to vet plugin. Aria Gomez: Also let's update the CONTRIBUTING.md note about heading punctuation — ask writers to avoid colons/emoji in headings where possible. Not a full fix but helps new content. Evan Li: PR 2789 opened: hotfix anchors + tools/dry-run script. Preview link: https://deploy-preview.docs.redwood/2789. Please review. Rina (docs): Quick reminder: when adding explicit anchors use the old mkdocs slug format: lowercase, spaces->-, remove punctuation except underscores. That keeps the mapping predictable. infra-team: We'll add a docs-build job that runs the slug-mapper script and fails if more than 5 unresolved anchors are added in a PR. QA-bot: rerun docs-ci/link-checker triggered by PR 2789. Aria Gomez: Thanks — once CI is green let's ship the hotfix to staging and run a full crawl for external links.
